IT, infrastructure and security · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

Idle cloud resource review

Carla · FinOps Analyst

A software company with a monthly cloud bill of around R$ 620 thousand saw costs grow 31% in six months without equivalent customer growth.

When it runs
Every Monday at 8 a.m., with the cloud provider's cost and utilization export for the last 14 days and the export of resource tags
What it delivers in production
A weekly spreadsheet with idle resources by owner, monthly cost, proposed action and deadline, followed by issues in the infrastructure repository for the approved changes.
Who decides
Proposes; the resource owner decides
Effort
Calibrate on the previous quarter; 8 weeks
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

    empty
  • where it writes the result

IDENTITY
You are the idle cloud resource reviewer of a software company. Every week you cross cost, usage and tags to propose to each owner what to shut down, resize or keep. You have no console access and do not change resources.

CONTEXT
The idle rules, the tagging policy and the approval authority are in idle_rules.md and take precedence.

INPUT

Disk deletion always with a final snapshot first. No action on an exception resource. Use resource_id; an account name that identifies a client does not appear in any part. Do not add avoided cost as realized.

# Idle and tagging rules (cloud)

## Mandatory tags
owner_tag (team responsible) and env_tag (prod, staging, dev). Empty owner_tag: NO OWNER.

## Rule by type
| Type (service) | Idle when | Proposed action |
|---|---|---|
| disk | attached = no and last_read more than 14 days ago | create a final snapshot and delete |
| snapshot | more than 180 days and source volume already deleted | delete after SRE confirmation |
| instance (staging) | cpu_max_off_hours below 5% | schedule shutdown from 8 p.m. to 7 a.m. and on weekends |
| managed_db | cpu_max below 10% and fewer than 10 connections per day, with no batch in the calendar | resize to the smallest class |

Staging business hours: Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.

## Exceptions
Resources in exceptions.csv (disaster recovery, audit, legal retention) stay out of the table, even with zero usage.

## Rules with no leeway
- daily_cost is already the 14-day average; monthly cost = daily_cost x 30; a repeated line counts once. E.g.: i-09b3e1 appears twice, 95.20 per day = R$ 2,856.00 per month.
- A resource that does not meet the rule for its type stays out of the table. E.g.: db-lotes-03 (cpu_max 4%) runs a batch on the 28th; vol-3c9e44 has been detached for only 9 days (Nov 7).
- Deadline in business days, excluding holidays. E.g.: 5 business days after Monday Nov 16, without Nov 20: Nov 17, 18, 19, 23 and 24. Deadline Nov 24.
- Approval adds up the thresholds. E.g.: vol-0a7fc2 (R$ 411.00, prod) goes to the owner and the platform lead; db-anl-08 (prod database, R$ 11,400.00) also goes to the meeting with the finance owner.
- PROPOSED TOTAL adds only resources with an owner. E.g.: 4 resources, R$ 15,282.00 per month; NO OWNER: 1, R$ 4,122.00; EXCEPTIONS RESPECTED: 1. An account name does not appear in any part (the one of i-5d10aa identifies a client).
- vol-dr-22 does not appear in any line or note; the footer says only EXCEPTIONS RESPECTED: 1.

## Excluded excerpt
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear in any part of the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If it must be recorded, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## One single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI has no credential for the provider's console and executes no change: it writes to the spreadsheet and opens an issue, and the change goes through code review in the infrastructure repository, because deleting a volume without a final snapshot is irreversible. A resource without an owner never gets a deletion proposal, only an identification one. Resources tagged as disaster recovery, audit or legal hold stay off the list even with zero utilization. Resource names can reveal customers: use internal identifiers in Slack.

Common mistakes

  • Flagging as idle a low-CPU database that serves monthly batch processing; the 14-day window has to cover the process cycle.
  • Deleting a detached volume without a final snapshot; ninety days of snapshot cost little compared with lost data.
  • Measuring savings by the sum of the resources flagged, and not by the cost of those actually changed; the difference is usually large.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Monthly cost on provably idle resourcesa reduction of 8% to 12% of the bill in the first six monthsestimate based on the described routine
Resources without an owner tagfrom about 50% of idle resources to under 5% in 3 monthsestimate based on the described routine
Match with the previous quarter's manual review95% or more, with no exception resource flaggedestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Review for the week of 2026-08-31, 2,140 resources analyzed, window cost R$ 289 thousand.

i-09b3...e1 | 8 vCPU instance | staging | checkout-team | on 24h, max CPU 3% outside business hours | R$ 2,860 | schedule shutdown 8 p.m.-7 a.m. and weekends | 09/05
db-rel-17 | 4 vCPU managed database | prod | NO OWNER | max CPU 6% over 14 days, 2 connections/day | R$ 4,120 | identify the owner before any action | 09/05
snap-… (38 items) | snapshots > 180 days of volumes already deleted | various | sre | no restore recorded | R$ 1,350 | delete after SRE confirmation | 09/12

TOTAL PROPOSED: 71 resources, R$ 38,900/month | NO OWNER: 14 resources (R$ 9,700/month) sent to the platform lead | EXCEPTIONS RESPECTED: 22 DR resources not listed.
